lineage_scope: Caller must independently validate frozen artifacts, source/cohort/predictions, target release and complete measurements before invoking this pure engine.

primary.scope: Descriptive finite-family pilot; no population confidence interval or nominal coverage claim

selection.seed_scope: All seeds retained; means describe ordering sensitivity on fixed programs, not independent population replicates.
selection.ordering_scope: Feasible predictions first by saved,formula,id; remaining by ascending point-cap then saved,formula,id. Spend min(budget,poolsize) attempts; final actual feasible and oracle ties use saved,formula,id only.
selection.cost_scope: One query per attempted candidate in each simulated program/policy case; physical union synthesis is deduplicated separately.
selection.zero_oracle_policy: Baseline saved0; normalized regret0 if oracle0; retention undefined/null and conditional denominator explicit.
selection.benefit_scope: Single-instruction overlap-safe saved retired instructions; never CPU cycles, frequency/speedup, or additive multi-instruction benefit.

limitations: All complete known/familiar formulas retained; novelty subsets need a separately frozen input-only family-completeness guard.
Measured feasibility is required for final selection; a point prediction is acquisition ordering only.

provenance.verification_scope: Authenticated original RTL and seeded vector shape/proof records; independent full oracle replay is a separate audit.

secondary_diagnostics.scope: Secondary consumed-test diagnostics; no novelty theorem, calibrated coverage claim, acquisition change or primary-row exclusion.
